---
title: "High contrast fixture"
format:
  revealjs:
    # A dark theme, so a background the high-contrast rules repaint white is
    # not white to begin with. With the default theme the background checks
    # pass whether or not the rules apply.
    theme: dark
    revealjs-plugins:
      - a11y
    revealjs-a11y:
      high-contrast: true
      alt-text-warnings: false
      pointer-indicator: true
---

A paragraph, and a [link](https://example.com).
